title: Pintando
subject: penguin painting a heart on easel, palette brush and one flower pot
prompt: ONE square drawing-game reference image for FIVE MINUTES of finger drawing on a PHONE. Lovely cute simple cartoon, big clear rounded shapes, thick smooth dark brown outlines, flat broad pastel colors with minimal soft shading. If an animal is specified, use round chubby body, dot eyes, tiny smile or triangle beak, small oval paws/flippers and blush. If no animal is specified, do NOT add an animal, face or character. Clear generous margins, all main objects visible. No photorealism, no 3D, no fur or paper texture, no glossy eyes, no fine patterns, no words, letters, labels, borders or UI. MEDIUM: upper TWO THIRDS background WHITE, much empty space. One main subject and 3-4 simple nearby objects. NO dense scenery, NO complete landscape behind mascot, just a small symbolic tree/mountain if specified and a simple ground baseline. Large shapes, 5-7 colors, about 25-35 strokes. SCENE: penguin painting a heart on easel, palette brush and one flower pot.
